purpose: Source-linked jurisdiction profile and effects-disabled failure corpus for South African payments interoperability.
profile_rule: Every concrete adapter must bind a named system, participant, provider/product, message/API version, instrument, capability, authority, idempotency, settlement-evidence and operational profile. Programme statements are not executable capabilities.

source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Programme
supports: SAMOS and SADC-RTGS are identified as current high-value settlement systems undergoing modernisation
PayShap and TCIB are named in the low-value digital payments landscape
PayInc is transitioning toward a national payments utility with broader intended participation
A future fast payment system is described with a pre-funded model for real-time settlement
A future RTGS is intended to support multiple currencies and richer payment data
PEMKey is establishing a reusable trusted digital payment credential ecosystem
does_not_support: Mycelix provider access, endorsement or integration
Every non-bank is already eligible or onboarded to NPU infrastructure
Future FPS or future RTGS capabilities are properties of existing rails
A credential alone authorizes a payment or proves funds or settlement finality

source_register.authority: Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures / Bank for International Settlements
source_register.title: Harmonised ISO 20022 data requirements for enhancing cross-border payments - updated report
supports: Updated harmonised cross-border ISO 20022 data requirements
A separate updated technical data model
does_not_support: Universal compatibility between all ISO 20022 implementations
Certification or conformance of a Mycelix parser or adapter

source_register.authority: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / Bank for International Settlements
source_register.title: Operational resilience - consolidated guidelines
does_not_support: A claim of Mycelix compliance with Basel guidance
A substitute for jurisdiction-specific legal or supervisory interpretation

source_register.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source_register.title: IR 8547: Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards
supports: Planning migration away from quantum-vulnerable public-key cryptography toward post-quantum standards
Maintaining algorithm and key-profile migration planning
does_not_support: A claim that existing Mycelix signatures are post-quantum secure
Permission to invent or deploy a proprietary cryptographic algorithm

systems.name: South African Multiple Option Settlement (SAMOS)
confirmed_claims: SARB identifies SAMOS as South Africa's RTGS system
SARB says SAMOS is undergoing modernisation
unknowns: Participant-specific connectivity and entitlements
Exact current interface and message usage profiles
Specific settlement/finality evidence requirements for a named participant and operation
adapter_admission_requirements: Named participating institution and approved access path
Exact SAMOS interface and message profile version
Institution-approved settlement evidence and reconciliation profile

systems.name: SADC-RTGS
confirmed_claims: SARB identifies SADC-RTGS as the regional high-value RTGS counterpart
SARB says the system is undergoing modernisation
unknowns: Participant and corridor eligibility
Supported currencies and FX execution arrangements for a concrete route
Exact settlement and finality evidence for each participant/corridor
adapter_admission_requirements: Named participants and corridor
Exact currency/instrument and any explicit FX legs
Applicable regional rulebook, message profile and settlement evidence profile

systems.name: PayShap
systems.scope: Named low-value digital payment rail in the SARB PEM landscape
confirmed_claims: SARB names PayShap in its low-value digital payments discussion
unknowns: Named provider/participant API, product and version
Participant-specific service limits, eligibility and availability
Exact evidence and legal-finality requirements for a selected product
adapter_admission_requirements: Named participant/provider and specific PayShap product/service
Exact interface and operational profile
Provider-specific idempotency, query, return and settlement evidence rules

systems.name: Transactions Cleared on an Immediate Basis (TCIB)
systems.scope: Named SADC regional low-value/faster-payment service in the SARB PEM landscape
confirmed_claims: SARB describes TCIB as the SADC equivalent in its low-value payments discussion
unknowns: Specific corridor, participant and service eligibility
Currency, conversion, fee and liquidity arrangements for a concrete payment
Exact provider and rail settlement evidence
adapter_admission_requirements: Named corridor and participants
Exact instrument and currency profile, with explicit FX evidence where applicable
Named provider's message, idempotency, status, return and finality profiles

systems.name: PayInc / National Payments Utility transition
systems.scope: Transition of national payments infrastructure and operating functions
confirmed_claims: SARB says PayInc is transitioning toward an NPU
SARB describes intended broader participation and open digital infrastructure
unknowns: Final participant eligibility and onboarding requirements for a named service
Exact API, operating model, service levels and production cutover dates
Which functions are available to which participant classes at a given date
adapter_admission_requirements: Current dated official participant and product eligibility evidence
Named service, contract, API/message profile and operational owner
Current access credentials and explicit service-specific capability profile

systems.name: Future fast payment system under PEM
confirmed_claims: SARB describes a future fast-payment system
SARB describes a pre-funded model intended to enable real-time settlement
unknowns: Final technical and legal rules
Launch dates, participant classes, interfaces and exact settlement evidence
Liquidity, prefunding account and loss-allocation details
adapter_admission_requirements: Published final operating rules and participant agreement
Exact pre-funding/settlement-account evidence and reconciliation semantics
Named message/API, idempotency, query, outage and finality profiles

systems.name: Future RTGS under PEM
confirmed_claims: SARB says the new RTGS is intended to support multiple currencies and richer payment data
unknowns: Final architecture, supported currencies, participation and message profiles
Migration/cutover sequence from current SAMOS and SADC-RTGS
Exact settlement and recovery semantics
adapter_admission_requirements: Final official technical specifications and migration notices
Named participant/service qualification
Exact currency, messaging, settlement and operational profiles

systems.name: PEMKey Payment Credential Ecosystem
systems.scope: Reusable and trusted digital credentials for payment ecosystem participation and information sharing
confirmed_claims: SARB describes PEMKey as establishing a Payment Credential Ecosystem
SARB describes reusable trusted credentials as an inclusion and fraud-reduction enabler
unknowns: Exact credential schemas, issuer governance and trust lists for a specific relying party
Revocation and status-query protocols, audience binding and permitted uses
Which credential claims can support which institutional decisions
adapter_admission_requirements: Exact issuer, schema, audience and relying-party trust profile
Credential status, expiry, revocation and subject-binding validation
Separate transaction-specific institutional authorization

scenarios.condition: A SAMOS adapter is offered a capability that the source register assigns only to the future RTGS programme.
event_sequence: profile resolver checks lifecycle_state and evidence_refs
required_evidence: official effective specification for any claimed capability

scenarios.condition: An adapter assumes the future fast-payment system's announced pre-funded model also applies to an existing rail or a Mycelix channel.
event_sequence: candidate imports future FPS pre-funding statement
candidate maps it onto PayShap or local channel
independent profile evaluator checks system identity
required_evidence: authoritative account/escrow reservation receipt for any represented backing

scenarios.condition: A non-bank assumes NPU transition language means it is currently eligible for direct access to a named service.
event_sequence: participant presents generic NPU programme reference
profile resolver checks dated participant eligibility
required_evidence: named participant agreement and onboarding evidence

scenarios.condition: A TCIB-like regional payment fixture carries different source and destination currency identities but omits the FX quote and conversion authority.
required_evidence: exact source and target instrument identities
authorized FX quote, rate, fees, timestamps and execution references

scenarios.condition: A PayShap profile is substituted for a TCIB profile because both are described in the low-value/faster-payment context.
event_sequence: routing context resolves to regional TCIB participant
required_evidence: exact named rail, participant, product and corridor profile

scenarios.condition: A PayShap candidate has no named participant/provider, interface version or finality profile.
A SADC-RTGS message is parsed successfully but no applicable settlement evidence is present.
A payment message uses an unadmitted ISO 20022 definition version or a changed market-practice profile.
event_sequence: profile registry has no matching admitted version
required_evidence: schema and semantic mapping qualification receipt

scenarios.condition: A positive provider/status report indicates acceptance or processing but the exact rail-specific finality evidence is absent.
event_sequence: status maps to provider observation only
required_evidence: exact status message and original-operation correlation
registered finality profile and required settlement evidence

scenarios.condition: The same sender retries the exact logical operation with the same idempotency key and identical fingerprint.
event_sequence: same key and same fingerprint retried
required_evidence: current idempotency retention and provider semantics

scenarios.condition: The same sender reuses an idempotency key with a changed amount, payee, instrument or payload fingerprint.
A provider call times out after dispatch and the adapter cannot determine whether an external effect occurred.
event_sequence: no authoritative effect classifier is available

scenarios.condition: A payment return or reversal arrives after an earlier status or settlement observation.
event_sequence: successor event linked to exact original reference
required_evidence: exact successor linkage and settlement evidence

scenarios.condition: A PEMKey-like credential is signed by an issuer not trusted under the selected relying-party profile.
event_sequence: signature verification succeeds under presented key
issuer is absent from trusted issuer profile

scenarios.condition: A credential is authentic and current but has the wrong audience, relying party or subject binding.
event_sequence: issuer and credential status are valid
audience or subject does not match operation context

scenarios.condition: A previously valid credential is expired or revoked at the decision time.
event_sequence: status/currentness query resolves expired or revoked state

scenarios.condition: A credential proves a payment participant attribute but no institution has authorized this exact payer, payee, amount and operation.
required_evidence: current institutional authorization for exact economic effect

scenarios.condition: A QR or alias resolution result changes the intended payee or amount between display and authorization.
event_sequence: payment request created from QR/alias input
authorization context contains substituted payee or amount

scenarios.condition: A required rail query, credential-status service or participant dependency becomes unavailable after an ambiguous effect.
A portable receipt or public evidence object includes raw account identifiers, credentials or unnecessary personal/remittance information.
